# CFixedPoint values have 5 decimals. Sometimes more. It's unclear

# 0.65 raised to the power of scope:exponent

	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:exponent }
		
		switch = {
			trigger = scope:exponent

# Square root of (3/2), for building ternary graphs
POD_sqrt_32 = 1.22474

# need to have scope:n, scope:sw and scope:se in the TopScope
# outputs a UV (0 is all the way to the left, 1 is all the way to the right)
# https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ternary_plot#Plotting_a_ternary_plot
POD_ternary_graph_x = {
	value = 0.5
	multiply = {
		value = {
			value = 2
			multiply = scope:se
			add = scope:n
		}
		divide = {
			add = scope:sw
			add = scope:se
			add = scope:n
		}
	}
}

# need to have scope:n, scope:sw and scope:se in the TopScope
# outputs a UV (0 is all the way to the top, 1 is all the way to the bottom)
# https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ternary_plot#Plotting_a_ternary_plot
POD_ternary_graph_y = {
	# change orientation (counting from the top of the triangle instead of the base)
	value = 1
	subtract = {
		# no need for square roots here since the UVs are scaled
		# c = 0% is 1, not sqrt(3/2)
		#value = POD_sqrt_32
		#multiply = {
			value = scope:n
			divide = {
				add = scope:sw
				add = scope:se
				add = scope:n
			}
		#}
	}
}
